title: SiDizen King and WES PERIOD - Sugar Lemon Tree
htmlContent:
SiDizen King and WES PERIOD shares a brand new single called "Sugar Lemon Tree". The two have been known to hold a flow but this time the pair are switching it up for something different. "Sugar Lemon Tree" is supreme Hip Hop that connects with the people. It got a global rating and for great reason. It hits every mark for a stellar record and is an undeniable piece of art.
